# Full Body Strength — Dumbbell Home Program

## Session (same structure both Tue and Thu, progress load week to week)

| # | Exercise | Sets x Reps | Notes |
|---|----------|-------------|-------|
| 1 | Low Incline DB Press | 3x6-8 | Set incline per sternum-angle test; press in "arrow" elbow path, not T-shape. Shoulder caution: stay pain-free ROM; single-arm if needed |
| 2 | DB Bulgarian Split Squat | 3x8-10/leg | Sub for barbell squat; rear foot elevated on bench |
| 3 | Wide-Grip Bent-Over DB Row | 3x10-12 | Sub for pull-up; elbows flared 45-90° (vs. tucked row below) for lat/width emphasis; horizontal pull, shoulder-friendly |
| 4 | DB Romanian Deadlift | 3x6-10 | Hip-width stance, hinge not squat; knees straighter = more hamstring, more bend = more glute |
| 5 | Chest-Supported DB Row | 3x10-15 | Chest on steep incline bench, elbows tucked, row to ribs for mid-back thickness |
| 6 | Lateral Raise Superset | 3x10-20 | Y-raise (back on bench) immediately into rear-delt raise (chest on bench). Shoulder caution: trim ROM or single-arm if it bothers left side |

## Accessory (pick 1-2 per session, rotate based on weak point)

- Dead Bug — 3x8/side (core/stability)
- Hip Abduction (banded or DB) — 3x10-20 (glute medius)
- Standing/straight-leg calf raise — 3x12-15
- DB Curl + Overhead Extension superset — 3x8-12
- Incline DB Kelso Shrug — 3x8-12 (upper back)
- Lean-forward DB Fly — 3x10-15 (upper chest)

## Progression rule

- Add reps within the range first; once top of rep range is hit with good form, add weight and drop back to bottom of range.
- Track load/reps per session in Soma to auto-flag stalls after 2 consecutive sessions with no progress.

## Block checkpoint

- Reassess at week 3-4: check interaction with running volume (fatigue, recovery, session quality). Adjust lifting volume down first if running is peaking, not the reverse.
- End of week 6: deload, reassess whether to repeat structure or shift back to a split.
